title: Alphabet & Letter Sounds
subject: Language Arts
description: Every letter makes its own special sound — from A to Z!

video.title: Phonics Song | Letter Sounds A to Z

steps: The alphabet has 26 letters, from A all the way to Z.
Every letter has a name AND a sound. The letter B is called 'bee' but it says /b/ like in ball.
When we put letter sounds together, we can read words!

questions.prompt: How many letters are in the alphabet?
questions.hint: Sing the alphabet song and count!

questions.prompt: What sound does the letter M make?
Which word starts with the /d/ sound?
questions.hint: Say each word slowly and listen to the first sound.

questions.prompt: What is the FIRST letter of the alphabet?
